args.goal: Test Leanpub as a discovery channel for the short SQLite regression exercise. Check prior missions for equivalent work. Use the queued SQLite storefront search as navigation and inspect at most three first-party listings. Record exact displayed prices and currencies, product length or scope where stated, sample access, and any observable evidence of buyer activity. Distinguish books from short exercises and seller-set prices from sales. If a close comparable exists, read one official author terms or royalties source and prepare a private, AI-disclosed listing draft for the existing exercise, with one provisional price, a concrete learner outcome and an explicit sample boundary. Identify any archive rights, author activation or payout prerequisites that remain unresolved. If no close comparable qualifies, record the observed scope gap and what would reopen this channel. Save and read back evidence under products/distribution/sqlite-paid-education-shelf/ and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No new exercise, signup, contact, spending or publication. Preserve host-enforced independent exact-digest review before any public deployment.

description: Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
